title: Repository first impression for evaluators: stale branches, internal files at the root, and a README with no Website / Docs / Cloud / Discussions row
body:
## Finding

From the www.objectos.ai seat 1 benchmark review on 2026-11-06, which compared twenty.com with objectos.ai and looked at the GitHub repos from an evaluator's point of view. The maintainer said 「立卡」 and asked the owning lanes to handle these.

Observed on https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack on 2026-11-06:
- **Branches:** the repo page shows about 1,586 branches. Most look like finished agent work branches.
- **Root files:** internal tooling files are visible at the root, for example `.claude/` and `paseo.json`, next to the product files.
- **README header:** the top of the README has no link row for Website / Docs / Cloud / Discussions. The benchmark repo has one, plus a pinned "start here" path.
- **Quick start:** three quick-start paths are worded differently across surfaces:
  - the README: `npm create objectstack@latest`;
  - the docs home: `npm i -g @objectstack/cli && os start`;
  - the www product tour: the `ghcr.io/objectstack-ai/objectstack` image.

## Suggested direction (for triage to decide)

- Prune merged or stale branches. Check the policy first; agent branches may be referenced by open PRs.
- Add a one-line link row near the top of the README.
- Put a single "I want to… → command" table in one place, and quote it from the README and the docs.
- Whether internal files should move is the governed-surface owners' call: `.claude/**` is governed.

Reach: the public repository page, the first thing a technical evaluator opens. No product behaviour changes.
